answer.content: Oh come ON, seriously?! I wanted that money back on my actual card, not locked up in some gift card! Ugh, fine — forget it then. If you can't refund my card, just return EVERYTHING from that order the gold tablet came in. The tablet, the camera, the coffee maker, the pet bed — all of it. And yeah, dump the whole refund onto that gift card since that's apparently the only way you people will do it. So annoying!
